programme.title: Age Defiantly - Beyond the Cholesterol Myth Upstream Cardiology AI Diagnostics and the Truth About GLP-1s with Dr Sanjay Bhojraj
programme.desc: In this episode of Age Defiant host Mark Young welcomes back cardiologist and functional medicine pioneer Dr Sanjay Bhojraj to challenge the conventional medical systems reliance on pharmacology and tech Dr Bhojraj argues that while the standard system isolates metrics like LDL cholesterol up to 80 of cardiovascular disease could be melted away by addressing root-cause lifestyle issues like sleep stress trauma and environmental toxicities The conversation explores the shifting landscape of patient advocacy highlighting how AI can act as a powerful research assistant to eliminate clinical biases and help patients ask better questions Turning to todays massive weight-loss trend Mark and Dr Bhojraj deliver a critical warning regarding GLP-1 agonists They discuss the biological realities of receptor overloading the psychological impacts on dopamine and human connection and the severe risks of medically induced malnutrition Dr Bhojraj shares details on his GLP Rescue program designed to help patients navigate these treatments safely before wrapping up with unsexy but essential daily habits—and a surprising mental health tool—that keep the human engine thriving well into your second fifty

programme.title: Fireborn Ministries - Living UnAnxious-Reclaiming Your Peace with Gabriel Andreson
programme.desc: Anxiety doesn’t knock It walks in takes a seat and dares you to pretend it’s not there It does not care how capable you appear or how much responsibility you carry Anxiety quietly steals focus sleep and clarity often from people who look strong on the outside but feel worn down on the inside If that feels familiar you are not alone More than 40 million adults in the United States struggle with anxiety each year Millions of Christians quietly carry this burden as well wondering how faith fits into panic attacks stress and emotional trials In UnAnxious entrepreneur and business leader Gabriel Andreson shares his journey through burnout and rebuilding his inner life At one point the pressure threatened his health his leadership and the life he had worked so hard to build Raised by parents who pastored in the Vineyard movement he grew up immersed in faith yet still found himself overwhelmed at the height of responsibility His story is not about faith failing but about faith being refined under pressure For more information go to firebornministriescom

programme.title: The Tenpenny Files - How Does God Use Suffering for Our Good - Pastor Clay Jones and Jean E Jones
programme.desc:
Do the heartbreaks losses medical crises and relational fractures of life carry meaning Does suffering hold depth that shapes the soul Pastor Clay Jones and Jean Jones confront that question through miscarriage infertility foster parenting high-needs children cancer and major surgery They present suffering as God’s chosen instrument for forming character and preparing believers for eternity “No one gets through this life without immense suffering” That statement sets the tone Suffering is not rare It is inevitable The issue is not its presence The issue is its purpose “How has suffering impacted your own life” Jean reaches a place many believers quietly fear She begins to ask whether she is angry at God Five miscarriages force her to confront entitlement grief and surrender She describes placing her pain before the cross as an offering She describes learning to trust without explanation Clay makes a claim that unsettles comfort “God’s plan A for your life is to take you through regular periods of suffering There is no plan B” He connects endurance to character He connects character to hope He speaks from bone cancer and open heart surgery He speaks from experience that refuses sentiment Hard questions surface Is turning to medical care a lack of faith How do you weigh quality of life against quantity of life What do you say when someone cries How do you remember God’s past faithfulness when fresh hardship reopens old wounds This conversation does not attempt to remove the weight of suffering It asks what suffering is producing Does suffering as they describe it function as formation within God’s larger design
Meet the Guests Clay Jones DMin is a former pastor who for 16 years was a professor in the Master of Arts of Christian Apologetics program at Talbot School of Theology He is the author of Why Does God Allow Evil and Immortal Learn more at httpsamznto4camQ3K and clayjonesnet Jean E Jones is co-author of five books including Discovering Joy in Philippians She is a member of Women in Apologetics and a Bible teacher Her writing has appeared in Crosswalkcom Todays Christian Woman and HomeLife Magazine Learn more at jeanejonesnet Purchase the book at httpsamznto4camQ3K
